B edges ahead because it keeps a short MC entry check to give the VP the scale they want, confirms the plan fits the 2-hour budget per rep, and gives a direct line for persuading the VP. A makes the clearer recognize-versus-produce point, and its recordings idea is good. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend B and cut the lead's load to about 6 hours by having the lead run one round per rep and pairing reps for the rest.
